# Part 06 · KV Caching

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcjpCfWR9pu/) · Published 27 Aug 2026

> Why does a long conversation eat your GPU memory?

To write token 100, attention needs the keys and values of the 99 before it. Without a cache, the GPU recomputes all of them at every step.

## The idea

- Compute each token's key and value once and keep them in GPU memory.
- Each new step computes only the new token's query.
- The cache grows with prompt length and with the number of users, until it can take more memory than the model weights.

## The formula

$$
\text{Memory}_{\text{KV}} = 2 \times n_{\text{layers}} \times n_{\text{heads}} \times d_k \times \text{seq\_len} \times \text{bytes}
$$
